title: Kip In Minecraft
description: It's a mod that adds Kip from Minigame Mayhem (by FizzelGames) to Minecraft! You can even eat him!
body:
Are you a fan of Minecraft? Are you a fan of Minigame Mayhem (by FizzelGames)? Well you're lucky this mod exists, because it mixes those two games together!
This mod adds Kip from Minigame Mayhem, in which you can craft with 5 Iron Ingots, 1 Redstone and 1 Yellow Glass Pane! Wow! After you craft him, nothing happens! Only thing you can do with him is eat him! Do not do that though, as you will perish.
